headline: South Korea's celebrity shark back in canal, prompting new rescue bid

body_markdown:
The shark - nicknamed Bukhangi by fans - has drawn more than 1.6 million visitors to a canal in South Korea’s Busan since it was first spotted there last month. (Channel NewsAsia)

**The Guardian Asia** adds: Famous shark has attracted more than 1.6m visitors since first getting trapped in the canal in September. On Thursday a new attempt was underway to free it A shark that became a viral sensation after getting stuck in a South Korean canal for a month has returned just hours after being coaxed out to sea.

**BBC News Asia** adds: Authorities had hoped the female shark would swim back to sea after being led out of the canal.

**The Straits Times Asia** adds: The authorities are unsure why it keeps returning, but concerns for its health are mounting.
